title: Council of the European Union (Consilium) Traineeship
description: A five-month paid traineeship at the General Secretariat of the Council of the European Union in Brussels, giving EU graduates hands-on exposure to the EU's legislative and policy-making process. Around 110 places are available each year. Trainees receive a monthly grant of EUR 1,538.16, a canteen card for the Council's restaurant, and discounted access to the on-site fitness centre; those recruited from more than 50km outside Brussels also receive a contribution toward travel expenses at the start and end of the traineeship (conditional on completing at least half the traineeship), though trainees arrange and pay for their own accommodation. A dedicated Positive Action Programme adds up to a 50% top-up to the grant for EU nationals with a recognised disability. Applicants must be EU citizens holding at least a Bachelor's degree, with C1-level English or French plus working knowledge of one other EU official language. This entry covers the session running 1 February to 30 June 2027: applications are open now, with a deadline of 15 September 2026, 12:00 Brussels time.
org: Council of the European Union (General Secretariat)
visaNote: Restricted to EU citizens, who do not need a separate work visa to intern in Belgium.
